en.title: English
en.intro: Learn the building blocks of English sentences.

sections.heading: Parts of speech
text: Every word has a job in a sentence.
list: Noun – a person, place or thing: teacher, school, book
Verb – an action: run, read, eat
Adjective – describes a noun: big, red, happy

sections.heading: Articles: a, an, the
text: Use 'a' before a consonant sound and 'an' before a vowel sound. Use 'the' for something specific.

image.alt: a dog, an apple, the sun
image.caption: a, an and the

sections.code:
a book      an apple
a dog       an egg
the sun     the book on the table

sections.heading: Simple present tense
text: Use the simple present for habits and facts. With he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
sections.code:
I play football.
She plays football.
They read books every day.

zh.title: 英文
zh.intro: 認識組成英文句子的基本元素。

sections.heading: 詞類
text: 每個單字在句子裡都有自己的功能。
list: 名詞 (noun)：人、地方或東西，例如 teacher（老師）、school（學校）、book（書）
動詞 (verb)：動作，例如 run（跑）、read（讀）、eat（吃）
形容詞 (adjective)：描述名詞，例如 big（大的）、red（紅色的）、happy（快樂的）

sections.heading: 冠詞：a、an、the
text: 子音發音開頭的字前面用 a，母音發音開頭的字前面用 an。the 用來指特定的人事物。
sections.code:
a book      an apple
a dog       an egg
the sun     the book on the table

sections.heading: 現在簡單式
text: 現在簡單式用來描述習慣和事實。主詞是 he、she、it 時，動詞要加 -s。
sections.code:
I play football.
She plays football.
They read books every day.
